name: icon-button
title: IconButton
description: A square, icon-only action button (Fluent 2's icon-only Button) with Button's appearances in small, medium and large, disabled and loading states, and a required aria-label.

manifest.name: icon-button
manifest.title: IconButton
manifest.description: A square, icon-only action button (Fluent 2's icon-only Button) with Button's appearances in small, medium and large, disabled and loading states, and a required aria-label.
manifest.usage: Use IconButton where a familiar icon says enough and space is tight: toolbars, table rows, inside an InputGroup. Put an Icon (`<Icon icon={Copy} />`, @/lib/icons) inside and describe the action in aria-label ("Copy connection string", not "Copy icon"); the type requires it. Subtle is the default; use primary for the one main action of a toolbar. When the icon is not obvious, use a Button with text instead. The old variant prop (ghost is subtle) and sm/md/lg still work for one release.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name: what the button does. Required by the type.

props.name: size
props.description: A square of size.control.* (24, 32, 40 px comfortable; 22, 28, 34 compact) with Fluent's 16, 20 or 24 px icon.

props.name: variant
props.description: The old name of appearance; ghost maps to subtle. Kept for one release.

props.name: size (sm, md, lg)
props.description: The old size names, mapped to small, medium and large. Kept for one release.

props.name: loading
props.description: Running: aria-busy and data-loading, ignores clicks, stays focusable.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element (a link) with the button's props.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The button; data-slot="icon-button", data-appearance, data-size and data-loading name it.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: The child Icon, sized to size.icon.md, lg or xl (16, 20, 24 px) by the button's size.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over the button: the appearance's hover fill (subtle turns its icon to the accent).

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: Fluent's double ring (@/lib/control focusRing).

states.name: disabled
states.description: Ignores interaction: Fluent's disabled fill and text.

states.name: loading
states.description: Running: aria-busy, ignores clicks, stays focusable, shown as disabled.

accessibility: Renders a native <button> with type="button" unless type is set, so Enter and Space activate it.
aria-label is required by the type and names the action; Icon is aria-hidden without its own label, so the name is not read twice.
Disabled uses the native disabled attribute; loading keeps the button focusable so focus is not lost mid-action, and sets aria-busy.

The small size (size.control.sm, 22 px in compact) passes WCAG 2.2 target size (minimum 24 px) only with spacing around it; keep IconButtons at least gap-inline-xs apart, or use medium in dense toolbars.

The focus ring shows for keyboard focus only: an outline in color.ring (kept in forced-colours mode) around color.ring-inner, at least 3:1 on every surface and layer; every appearance's colours are contrast-checked by the token build.
